mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of commercial transactions developed in the United Kingdom and can now be found in existence all over the world now."
The concept of Hire Purchase is an important aspect of commercial transactions developed in the United Kingdom and can now be found in existence all over the world now.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bailment of goods but with a provision for the option of sale or transfer of the property in the goods bailed from the bailor to the bailee."
A Hire Purchase transaction is a bailment of goods but with a provision for the option of sale or transfer of the property in the goods bailed from the bailor to the bailee.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agent of necessity endowed by law with authority to pledge her husband's credit for necessaries."
A deserted wife is an agent of necessity endowed by law with authority to pledge her husband's credit for necessaries.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible irrespective of whether he knew, or ought to have known, or inadvertently thought that he had the authority he was supposed to have professed."
The agent alone is responsible irrespective of whether he knew, or ought to have known, or inadvertently thought that he had the authority he was supposed to have professed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the power or right reposed in that agent by the principal."
Authority of an agent simply means the power or right reposed in that agent by the principal.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agreement that is precipitated on the general rule of contract of law of offer and acceptance on the part of the hirer and that of the owner."
A hire-purchase agreement is an agreement that is precipitated on the general rule of contract of law of offer and acceptance on the part of the hirer and that of the owner.
fib: ______ are a peculiar type of agents whose rights, duties and obligations are often spelt out in an agreement, mostly Power of Attorney.
Estate agents are a peculiar type of agents whose rights, duties and obligations are often spelt out in an agreement, mostly Power of Attorney.
______ is an essential part of commercial law because companies can only conduct business through agents.
The law of agency is an essential part of commercial law because companies can only conduct business through agents.
______ is an essential ingredient to determine the existence or otherwise of agency.
Knowledge of insanity is an essential ingredient to determine the existence or otherwise of agency.
______ is one of confidentiality of principal and the agent, and the agent is generally expected to perform his duties as an agent, personally.
Agency relationship is one of confidentiality of principal and the agent, and the agent is generally expected to perform his duties as an agent, personally.
______ is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.

A mercantile agent is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.
